ValidationRule.description: Prevents an Employment Change Item from being marked Implemented without required Payroll decision and implementation evidence.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Item_Status__c, "Implemented"), OR( NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Payroll_Decision__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Payroll_Decision__c, "Modified") ) ), ISBLANK(Implemented_Value__c), ISBLANK(Implemented_Effective_Date__c), ISBLANK(Payroll_Transaction_ID__c), AND( ISPICKVAL(Change_Type__c, "Work Location"), ISBLANK(Implemented_Work_Location__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot mark this item Implemented without an Approved or Modified Payroll decision and complete implementation evidence.
